predictions.selection: Sir Susa Scai Perugia Match Winner (1.58 / -172)
predictions.text: Sir Susa Scai Perugia to win at 1.58 (-172) is our SuperLega Round 2 selection for Sunday 25 October, when Volleyball World lists the match in Perugia at 17:00 UTC, 18:00 local time. Perugia won their opener 3-2 at Acqua Sant'Anna Cuneo on 18 October, taking the deciding set 25-23 after losing the first 25-18; Ferre Reggers top-scored with 18 points and Kamil Semeniuk added 13. Tinet Prata di Pordenone are the visitors, and the away side's attack has to hold up against a Perugia block that scored seven points in Round 1. The price sits inside the -250 to +10000 window.

predictions.selection: Abel/Moda Brusque W to win the match at 1.71 (-141)
predictions.text: Abel/Moda Brusque W to beat Praia Clube W is the selection in this Brazil Superliga Feminina Round 2 fixture, published as analysis and not as a high-confidence pick. The evidence behind it is thin and is described as such. OLBG's listing carries the Win Match market with both of its two tips on Brusque, and our 55.5% read comes from shrinking that two-tip split toward an even Beta(2,2) prior plus the disclosed home-court adjustment for the sport; two tips is close to no sample at all, which is why the price of 1.71 (-141) sits near a pick-'em despite the unanimous crowd lean. No official form supports the call. The venue and local kick-off previously published on this row have been withdrawn, because the record transcribed from the Brazilian federation's listing carried the arena and clock of a different Round 2 fixture, and the earlier version of this write-up repeated that error by describing Brusque as near-unbeatable at home in an arena that is not Brusque's home. Those fields are now blank and the row carries no official confirmation rather than a corrected one, since the right values could not be re-read and must not be guessed from adjacent rows. The earlier claims about building momentum, a strong serving rotation troubling opponents in Round 1 and home-court energy are likewise removed: no retrieved source states them. Standings, recent results and player availability for both clubs are blank.
